claim work-rate-calculation
  Pump A empties 1/6 tank per hour and Pump B empties 1/8 tank per hour; in 2 hours together they empty 2(1/6 + 1/8) = 7/12 of the tank, leaving 5/12, which Pump A empties in (5/12)/(1/6) = 2.5 hours, for 2 + 2.5 = 4.5 hours total.

claim final-answer
  The answer is B.

link work-rate-calculation supports final-answer

model holds final-answer
  confidence 1 assumed
